description: This file defines the EntityEcaHandler interface for handling entity lifecycle events and rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes constants for event names and operations, and declares methods for setting a delegator, retrieving event mappings, and evaluating rules.

classes.name: EntityEcaHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling entity lifecycle events and rules in OFBiz, parameterized by a type T.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the Delegator used by the handler.

methods.name: getEntityEventMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of event lists keyed by string, for a specific entity name.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates entity operation rules based on current operation, event map, specific event, entity value, and error flag.
